description: Returns deterministic, copy-paste code for one audit check on one stack. No network access. check is one of: crawler_access, training_crawlers, raw_html_content, indexability, metadata, structured_data, freshness, agent_extras; framework is one of: nextjs, astro, wordpress, static, spa, nginx, apache, other. Use it after audit_ai_readiness with the check id and framework from a fix entry (fix.snippetId and fix.framework).

check.description: Check id from an audit result (fix.snippetId)

framework.description: Stack of the site. Defaults to other (generic).

name: get_fix_snippet
title: Get a copy-paste fix
